gateway_exclusions.reason: All source gateway sites retained, including zero attachments

provenance.registration: fixed nearest source gateway regardless of attachment; ties by gateway ID
provenance.destination_model: one unique prefix per gateway; no PoP mapping

coverage.limitation: Coverage is dated by the source publication; no inference of current service or address capacity.

sampling.method: with-replacement population-count weighted cell centers; PCG64
sampling.boundary_cells: cell-center inclusion; no partial-cell population allocation

sampling.population: GHS-POP R2023A E2020 WGS84 30 arcseconds V1.0; persons per cell
sampling.population_attribution: European Commission, Joint Research Centre, GHSL

provenance.positions: SGP4 2.25 WGS72; TEME to pseudo-Earth-fixed via GMST; UT1=UTC, polar motion ignored
provenance.ground: WGS84, altitude zero; gateway cap 8, elevation 25 degrees; satellite GSL limits and selection in attachment_rules
provenance.user_attachments: held fixed at before time; unattached users retained as baseline-unreachable
provenance.update_scope: all gateway attachment changes between the two times
